headline: Canadian Metals Face European Union Carbon Border Levy
summary: Canadian iron, steel, and aluminum exporters face new costs as the European Union carbon border levy entered its definitive phase.
why: The EU carbon border adjustment mechanism aims to prevent carbon leakage by imposing tariffs on carbon-intensive imports, directly impacting foreign metal producers.

impacts.name: Canadian metals sector
impacts.why: New carbon border levy costs affect Canadian iron, steel and aluminium exporters.
